_about: Josiah Royce (1855-1916), the American idealist: from Project Gutenberg, The Sources of Religious Insight (Bross Lectures; Scribner, 1912); and in raw IA OCR, The Religious Aspect of Philosophy (Houghton, Mifflin; copyright 1885), The Spirit of Modern Philosophy (copyright 1892), The World and the Individual (Gifford Lectures; Macmillan, 1900-1901, 2 vols.), The Philosophy of Loyalty (1908) and The Problem of Christianity (1913, 2 vols.). US public domain. Added in round 2026-10-18cj, raw IA OCR with title page years read: The Conception of God, his address with the replies of Joseph LeConte, G. H. Howison and Sidney Edward Mezes (Macmillan, 1897); Studies of Good and Evil (Appleton, 1898); The Conception of Immortality (Houghton Mifflin, Riverside Press, 1900); Outlines of Psychology (Macmillan, 1903, this printing 1906); Race Questions, Provincialism, and Other American Problems (1908); William James and Other Essays on the Philosophy of Life (1911); War and Insurance (1914); The Hope of the Great Community (1916); Lectures on Modern Idealism (Yale, 1919) and Fugitive Essays (Harvard, 1920), both edited by J. Loewenberg. No uids minted.
